item.title: Captain Nick Suzuki one of four Canadiens headed to Olympics
item.description: Juraj Slafkovsky (Slovakia), Oliver Kapanen (Finland) and Alexandre Texier (France) will be looking to beat Team Canada and Suzuki.

item.title: Fitness: Hail to the comeback kids — at any age
item.description: The ability of elite athletes to compete in their late 30s and early 40s can be motivation for the average Joe and Jill who want to rekindle their athletic dreams despite approaching mid-life.

item.title: Montreal weather: Bundle up — there's a risk of frostbite Sunday
item.description: It will remain clear overnight with a low of minus 17 and a wind chill of minus 25.

item.title: Early-morning bar fire in Rosemont—La Petite-Patrie investigated as arson
item.description: Montreal police and firefighters responded to 911 calls shortly after 6 a.m. Sunday at a bar on Papineau Ave. near St-Zotique St.

item.title: Man stabbed at Place-des-Arts métro station
item.description: The incident took place Saturday at around 10 p.m.

item.title: Montreal's Félix Auger-Aliassime defends Montpellier title
item.description: Sunday's win over France's Adrian Mannarino was the ninth tour-level singles title for the 25-year-old, making him the Canadian with the most men's singles titles in the Open Era.

item.title: Quebec snowboarder Arnaud Gaudet misses Olympic semifinal by three-hundredths of a second
item.description: Gaudet was competing Sunday in the parallel giant slalom at the Milan Cortina Olympics.

item.title: Former L'Assomption daycare worker found guilty of murder in toddler's death
item.description: Tomy Carranza Ladry had already confessed to attacking the 18-month-old child; the jury's duty was to determine whether he had intended to inflict injuries that could have caused the toddler's death.

item.title: What's next for the old Royal Vic site? Not student housing, at least for now
item.description: A feasibility study puts the cost of upgrading the former Royal Victoria Hospital's heritage buildings at nearly 79 per cent of the estimated $845-million construction cost for 1,150 beds.

item.title: Letters: Reality check — a constitution doesn't belong to one person
item.description: "It seems to me, contrary to (Simon) Jolin-Barrette’s display of dictatorial arrogance, that changes to this bill should be made independently by the legislative committee examining the bill."
